capabilities: Plays 12 classic games in a popup, tab, or hub
Sets Easy / Normal / Hard difficulty per game
Launches games from ribbon icon or command palette
Syncs results to the OBSIGAMA game hub (optional)
extras: Manual install only (not in the official Community plugins list); requires Obsidian 1.0.0+; fully offline with no ads or accounts; optional OBSIGAMA sync is off by default and never alters local stats; saves from Mini Games (mini-games) or Mini Old Games 1.0.3 are not migrated.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in games, so taking a short break means leaving the app or opening a browser.

relations.evidence: If you also install the OBSIGAMA plugin (a game hub for Obsidian)

summary: Collection of 12 classic mini-games (Snake, Tetris, 2048, Minesweeper and more) playable inside Obsidian with per-game difficulty, stats and achievements.
